lesson: The trade failed by attempting to catch a falling knife during a blow-off top, ignoring the Wyckoff distribution phase forming on the 30m timeframe. The system incorrectly prioritized short-term bullish momentum over the overextended RSI and Bollinger Band exhaustion signals.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'no-long' filter when RSI exceeds 75 on the 30m timeframe until a clear re-accumulation structure is confirmed.
